_comment: The .claude/settings.json hook ENTRIES this system adds (SessionStart world-watch reminder, PostToolUse dossier-freshness, PreToolUse ExitPlanMode review-suggestion). Merge these into the `hooks` object of .claude/settings.json (create the file if a fresh checkout has none). If a SessionStart/PreToolUse array already exists (e.g. the commit-gate uses PreToolUse), APPEND these entries rather than replacing the array. See ../DESIGN.md → 'Rebuild local tooling'.
